clues.text: In Matthew's genealogy of Jesus, David is named the father of Solomon by this man's wife.
Called back from the war by David, he slept at the palace door with the king's servants.
He would not go home to his wife while the ark and Israel's army stayed in tents.
His wife mourned for him when she heard he was dead, and then King David brought her to his house.
He carried a letter from David to Joab that said to put him at the front of the fiercest battle.
The prophet Nathan told David he had killed this man with the sword of the Ammonites.
He is named last in the list of King David's mighty warriors, thirty-seven in all.
